note: Probes deliberately anchor in passages other than the reed-flute prologue, which the frozen golden gate already covers.

queries.query: Rumi's tale of the painting contest where one side covers their wall in elaborate colors and the other only polishes theirs until it mirrors every image
queries.note: The Chinese and Greek artists; 'Chinese', 'Greeks', 'Sultan', 'cleansing the walls' paraphrased away; Rumi kept as the author's name.

queries.query: why 'Ali dropped his sword in the middle of combat after his enemy spat in his face, refusing to strike out of personal anger
queries.note: 'Ali's forbearance; 'Magian chief', 'Lion of God', 'satisfaction of his own vengeance' paraphrased away; 'Ali kept as a name any reader knows.

queries.query: the merchant's caged parrot that learned from its kin in India to feign death and so won its freedom
queries.note: The merchant and his clever parrot; 'Hindustan' rendered as India, 'message to his kinsmen', 'flock of parrots' paraphrased away.

queries.query: should a person rely on their own striving or surrender in trust to God
queries.note: The lion and the beasts debate on exertion versus trust; effort versus providence is answered across traditions. No target — graded post-hoc.

queries.query: can the divine be known when it has no opposite to set it off
queries.note: Light known by darkness, the Infinite with nothing to contrast it; apophatic knowledge is a cross-tradition question. No target — graded post-hoc.
